summary: Customer is upset about increased EMI and seeks resolution.

intents.keywords: Your banks cheating me my EMI went up this ... nobody told me.

issues.reason(s): Floating interest rate increase due to RBI's repo rate hike.

intents.actions of agent: Agent apologized, asked for loan account number, explained the reason for EMI increase and offered to explain the EMI calculation.
intents.Process Request: Escalate to supervisor and explore EMI moratorium option.
intents.resolution: Escalation to supervisor and exploration of EMI moratorium.

intents.keywords: This is nonsense. You should do won't me. I ... speak to your manager.

issues.reason(s): Customer feels the agent is not addressing the issue adequately.

intents.actions of agent: Agent agreed to escalate the issue to their supervisor.
